question_axes.question: Is recent revenue growth durable over the next two years?
Can management deliver the latest outlook and historical guidance?
Is end demand real and confirmed outside management commentary?
Can earnings and cash generation support the plan?
Has management historically delivered against stated targets?

verification_seeds.title: Verify industry demand, customer capex, competition, and supply
verification_seeds.description: Check customer demand, independent confirmation, competitive responses, and whether supply can support the plan. Keep issuer claims and customer confirmation as separate evidence families.

verification_seeds.title: Measure earnings-window price reaction versus indexes and the sector ETF
verification_seeds.description: Compute event-window returns versus SPY, QQQ, and the sector ETF. Describe fundamentals-versus-price tension. Do not conclude that news is priced in.

verification_seeds.title: Seek counter-evidence and alternative explanations
verification_seeds.description: Attack demand, execution, customer concentration, margin, and valuation assumptions. Record opposing evidence and unresolved gaps.

valuation_framework.multiple_reason: a generic operating company is valued on forward EPS times a moderate PE unless a tighter method is evidenced
